verdict.rationale: Wrike's own pricing page says users can "build no-code automations" and "run end-to-end workflows". It also lists natural-language automation rule generation and agent-built workflows, which together cover no-code, multi-step automation for a PM. The evidence is marketing-level only, and the multi-step nature is implied by "end-to-end workflows" rather than documented. Missing for 10: detailed docs on chaining triggers, conditions and actions into multi-step rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build multi-step automations without writing code

citations.quote: Connect Wrike to your apps, build no-code automations, and run end-to-end workflows from one secure platform.
Build workflows with Wrike agents and let them handle your everyday tasks.
